question_text:
Let $a,$ $b,$ $c$ be complex numbers satisfying
\begin{align*}
(a + 1)(b + 1)(c + 1) &= 1, \\
(a + 2)(b + 2)(c + 2) &= 2, \\
(a + 3)(b + 3)(c + 3) &= 3.
\end{align*}Find $(a + 4)(b + 4)(c + 4).$

Return only the final boxed answer content as a concise mathematical expression.
